name: devtool 0.5.8 clipboard monitor service
description: Complete devtool source repository with optional installable Qt desktop clipboard monitoring service.
highlights: Installable per-user clipboard monitor service for devtool commands and local artifacts
Artifact schema v2 inventory and repository identity
Embedded target, validation policy, and commit message
Atomic monorepo overlay bundles with dependency ordering
Disposable artifact validators executed from TMPDIR
Live target-scoped restore, build, and test HUD progress
Multi-workspace pipelines rendered as distinct operation segments
Live parser warning and error totals on desktop and Android
Wrapped four-column desktop and Android progress layouts
Automatic commits reconcile devtool artifact history
